BURNING_BLOOD.name: Burning Blood
BURNING_BLOOD.text: At the end of combat, heal 6 HP.

AKABEKO.name: Akabeko
AKABEKO.text: Your first Attack each combat deals 8 additional damage.

ART_OF_WAR.name: Art of War
ART_OF_WAR.text: If you do not play any Attacks during your turn, gain an additional 1 Energy next turn.

BAG_OF_MARBLES.name: Bag of Marbles

BAG_OF_PREPARATION.name: Bag of Preparation
BAG_OF_PREPARATION.text: At the start of each combat, draw 2 additional cards.

BLOOD_VIAL.name: Blood Vial

OMAMORI.name: Omamori

ORICHALCUM.name: Orichalcum

REGAL_PILLOW.text: Whenever you Rest, heal an additional 15 HP.

STRAWBERRY.name: Strawberry

TOY_ORNITHOPTER.name: Toy Ornithopter

BOTTLED_TORNADO.text: Upon pickup, choose a Power card. Start each combat with this card in your hand.

MOLTEN_EGG.name: Molten Egg
MOLTEN_EGG.text: Whenever you add an Attack into your deck, Upgrade it.

ORNAMENTAL_FAN.name: Ornamental Fan

SELF_FORMING_CLAY.name: Self-Forming Clay

SHURIKEN.name: Shuriken

TOXIC_EGG.name: Toxic Egg
TOXIC_EGG.text: Whenever you add a Skill into your deck, Upgrade it.

CHARONS_ASHES.text: Whenever you Exhaust a card, deal 3 damage to ALL enemies.

DEAD_BRANCH.text: Whenever you Exhaust a card, add a random card into your hand.

DU_VU_DOLL.name: Du-Vu Doll

GIRYA.name: Girya

ICE_CREAM.name: Ice Cream

LIZARD_TAIL.name: Lizard Tail

MAGIC_FLOWER.name: Magic Flower

MANGO.name: Mango

SHOVEL.name: Shovel

STONE_CALENDAR.name: Stone Calendar

THREAD_AND_NEEDLE.name: Thread and Needle

TORII.name: Torii

TUNGSTEN_ROD.name: Tungsten Rod

TURNIP.name: Turnip

UNCEASING_TOP.name: Unceasing Top

ASTROLABE.name: Astrolabe

BLACK_BLOOD.name: Black Blood

BLACK_STAR.name: Black Star

ECTOPLASM.name: Ectoplasm

EMPTY_CAGE.name: Empty Cage

FUSION_HAMMER.name: Fusion Hammer
FUSION_HAMMER.text: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. You can no longer Smith at Rest Sites.

MARK_OF_PAIN.name: Mark of Pain

PANDORAS_BOX.name: Pandora's Box
PANDORAS_BOX.text: Upon pickup, Transform all Strike and Defend cards.

PHILOSOPHERS_STONE.name: Philosopher's Stone

RUNIC_CUBE.name: Runic Cube
RUNIC_CUBE.text: Whenever you lose HP, draw 1 card.

RUNIC_DOME.name: Runic Dome

RUNIC_PYRAMID.name: Runic Pyramid

SNECKO_EYE.name: Snecko Eye

SOZU.name: Sozu

TINY_HOUSE.name: Tiny House

VELVET_CHOKER.name: Velvet Choker

BRIMSTONE.name: Brimstone

FROZEN_EYE.name: Frozen Eye

HAND_DRILL.name: Hand Drill

LEES_WAFFLE.name: Lee's Waffle

ORRERY.name: Orrery

PRISMATIC_SHARD.name: Prismatic Shard

SLING_OF_COURAGE.name: Sling of Courage
SLING_OF_COURAGE.text: Start each Elite combat with 2 Strength.

STRANGE_SPOON.name: Strange Spoon

THE_ABACUS.name: The Abacus

BLOODY_IDOL.name: Bloody Idol
BLOODY_IDOL.text: Whenever you gain Gold, heal 5 HP.

ENCHIRIDION.name: Enchiridion

FACE_OF_CLERIC.name: Face Of Cleric

MUTAGENIC_STRENGTH.name: Mutagenic Strength

NLOTHS_GIFT.name: N'loth's Gift

NLOTHS_HUNGRY_FACE.name: N'loth's Hungry Face

NEOWS_LAMENT.name: Neow's Lament

NILRYS_CODEX.name: Nilry's Codex

ODD_MUSHROOM.name: Odd Mushroom

RED_MASK.name: Red Mask
RED_MASK.text: At the start of each combat, apply 1 Weak to ALL enemies.

SSSERPENT_HEAD.name: Ssserpent Head
SSSERPENT_HEAD.text: Whenever you enter a? room, gain 50 Gold.

WARPED_TONGS.name: Warped Tongs
WARPED_TONGS.text: At the start of your turn, Upgrade a random card in your hand for the rest of combat.
